H0.title: Foundation & Headless Wire Protocol
H0.description: Establish in-process C++ StudioRuntime, headless QCoreApplication initialization, single-writer file locking, line-delimited JSON IPC, and request idempotency.

H1.title: DAW Capability Coverage & Compositional Agency
H1.description: Expose over 60 native LMMS C++ operations covering piano roll, beat sequencing, synth inspection, Scala microtuning, mixer sends, and offline audio rendering.

H2.title: Production Hardening, Multimodal Audio & Hardware
H2.description: Real-time multimodal audio critique loop, hardware audio/MIDI hot-swapping, VST3/CLAP hosting via Carla, and automated mastering compliance.

H3.title: Autonomous Studio Mesh & Timbral Synthesis
H3.description: Multi-agent stem jam sessions, zero-latency WebSocket studio relays, and neural timbre diffusion models.

gates.title: In-Process StudioRuntime & QCoreApplication Headless Mode
gates.criterion: Application boots headlessly without display server or GUI automation; stdio stream isolation redirects protocol to stdout and diagnostics to stderr.

gates.title: Line-Delimited JSON-Lines Wire Protocol
gates.criterion: 1 MiB frame bounds enforced; JSON request parsing and event notification frames ('ready', 'agent', 'shutdown') verified.

gates.title: Atomic Manifests and Single-Writer File Locking
gates.criterion: Single-writer lock (.lock) prevents multi-process corruption; .mmp checkpoints committed atomically via manifest.json swap.

gates.title: Request Idempotency & SHA-256 Receipt Caching
gates.criterion: Mutating requests fingerprinted via SHA-256; duplicate request IDs return cached response with replayed: true.

gates.title: Arrangement & Track Organization Capabilities
gates.criterion: track.add, track.edit, track.clone, track.remove, clip.add, clip.edit, clip.split, clip.clone, and clip.selection.copy verified.

gates.title: Piano Roll Batch Editing & Microtonal Detuning
gates.criterion: Batch insertion of up to 4096 notes, selection shift, quantize, reverse, length, glue, knife line cut, and per-note detuning curves.

gates.title: BeatMatrix Step Sequencer Operations
gates.criterion: step.set, step.resize, and step.clone mutate native beat-and-bassline patterns with unified undo boundaries.

gates.title: Bundled Instrument Loading & Slicer Integration
gates.criterion: Loading and inspection for TripleOscillator, ZynAddSubFX, AudioFileProcessor, SlicerT, Patman, and FluidSynth soundbanks.

gates.title: Scala Microtonal Tuning (.scl) & Keyboard Mapping (.kbm)
gates.criterion: Loading, programmatic setting, and frequency inspection for Scala .scl and .kbm files.

gates.title: Mixer Routing, Sends & Cycle Detection
gates.criterion: Mixer channel creation, fader/mute/solo adjustments, send routing with cycle prevention, and ordered effect inserts.

gates.title: Automation & Controller Rack Modulation
gates.criterion: Automation curves (discrete, linear, Hermite cubic), LFO controllers, and hardware MIDI CC learn binding.

gates.title: Offline Multi-Codec Audio Rendering & Technical DSP Analysis
gates.criterion: Rendering to WAV, FLAC, OGG, and MP3 with audio.analyze reporting peak dBFS, RMS, silence, and clipping.

gates.title: End-to-End Process Integration Test Harness
gates.criterion: 2600-line Python test suite exercises headless process lifecycle, protocol boundaries, signal interruption, and sound rendering.

gates.title: Live Multimodal Audio Critique & Revision Loop
gates.criterion: audio.listen submits rendered PCM to multimodal audio model and incorporates aesthetic feedback into revised composition.

gates.title: Hardware Audio/MIDI Backend Hot-Swapping & Fault Recovery
gates.criterion: Dynamic backend switching between PortAudio, ALSA, and JACK while running without crashing or corrupting timeline state.

gates.title: Multi-Track Stem Export & Automated Loudness Compliance
gates.criterion: Simultaneous multi-stem rendering with automated LUFS integrated loudness and true-peak compliance checking.

gates.title: Third-Party VST3 & CLAP Hosting via Carla Bridge
gates.criterion: Host VST3/CLAP plugins headlessly with parameter inspection and automation modulation.

gates.title: Cross-Session Musical Preference & Palette Memory
gates.criterion: session.memory.set preserves compositional rules, favorite instruments, and sound palettes across studio restarts.

gates.title: Multi-Agent Jam Session & Stems Collaboration Mesh
gates.criterion: Multiple autonomous agents collaborate on separate tracks with shared tempo clock and stem listening.

gates.title: Real-Time Neural Timbre Diffusion Synthesis
gates.criterion: Native C++ bridge to real-time neural diffusion models for acoustic timbre transformation.

gates.title: Zero-Latency WebSocket Remote Studio Relay
gates.criterion: WebSocket transport allowing browser and mobile agents to drive in-process studio runtime across networks.
